profile.role_note: HP-scaling Aero Erosion DPS; transforms into Fleurdelys via Liberation.

pull_verdict.source_guide: research: community build sources (no site pull guide exists)
pull_verdict.verdict: Still an elite Aero Erosion DPS with one of the highest ceilings; worth pulling, but she really wants her signature weapon and Ciaccona beside her.

build.fast_path: Fast path: Defier's Thorn (or Red Spring) + 5-piece Windward Pilgrimage in a 4-4-1-1-1 layout (Crit Rate on one 4-cost, Crit DMG on the other) with Reminiscence: Fleurdelys in the main slot. Aim for ~50,000 HP, a 70:270 Crit balance, and 115-120% Energy Regen; keep 5 Aero Erosion stacks up before casting Liberation.

ranked_weapons.name: Defier's Thorn
ranked_weapons.note: Her signature and the only real HP-scaling sword. HP%, Aero DMG, DEF ignore, and DMG amp on Eroded enemies. Losing it costs a lot of damage.

ranked_weapons.name: Red Spring
ranked_weapons.note: Crit Rate substat with Basic Attack DMG synergy; decent second-best.

ranked_weapons.name: Blazing Brilliance
ranked_weapons.note: High ATK and Crit DMG; workable stat stick.

ranked_weapons.name: Unflickering Valor
ranked_weapons.note: Crit Rate and Basic Attack DMG on Liberation; usable alternative.

ranked_weapons.name: Emerald of Genesis
ranked_weapons.note: Crit Rate and Energy Regen; the ATK% passive is less ideal on her. Free last-resort alternative: the 3-star Guardian Sword.

echo_sets.name: Windward Pilgrimage
echo_sets.note: The Erosion DPS set: +10% Crit Rate and +30% Aero DMG after hitting an Aero Eroded enemy. Virtually guaranteed uptime on her.

echo_sets.name: Gusts of Welkin
echo_sets.note: Same Aero DMG bonus without the extra Crit Rate; use while farming Windward Pilgrimage.

echo_sets.name: Sierra Gale
echo_sets.note: Pre-Rinascita placeholder with unconditional Aero DMG on Intro.

stat_priorities.note: One 4-cost Crit Rate, one Crit DMG; aim for a 1:2 ratio (70:270). Consider HP% on one if you lack the signature.
HP% on both 1-costs; 1-costs are her only source of flat HP.

teams.name: Premium: Cartethyia + Ciaccona + Chisa

members.name: Cartethyia
members.note: HP-scaling Aero Erosion hypercarry; transforms into Fleurdelys via Liberation.

members.name: Ciaccona
members.note: Essential Aero Erosion enabler; supplies stacks and Aero buffs at S0.

members.name: Chisa
members.note: Raises the Aero Erosion stack cap, reduces enemy DEF, and provides Havoc Bane.

teams.rotation: Chisa opens with skill and Basics to build Forte, Liberation, then skill into Forte depletion; Ciaccona applies Erosion and buffs; Cartethyia enters, stacks Erosion, and transforms into Fleurdelys for the burst window.

teams.name: Budget: Cartethyia + Sanhua + Shorekeeper

members.name: Cartethyia
members.note: Without Ciaccona she needs an Aero DMG 3-cost echo; Sanhua covers the sub-DPS slot.

members.name: Sanhua
members.note: Quick-swap sub-DPS; her Outro buffs Basic Attack DMG, which much of Cartethyia's damage counts as.

members.name: Shorekeeper
members.note: Healing plus Crit and All-Type DMG buffs inside Stellarealm.

teams.rotation: Shorekeeper deploys Stellarealm, Sanhua quick-swaps in for her Outro buff, then Cartethyia runs her Erosion-stacking combo into Fleurdelys. Use a 4-3-1-1-1 layout with an Aero DMG 3-cost when Ciaccona is absent.

tier_badge.label: Excellent
tier_badge.note: Still an elite Aero Erosion DPS; power-crept but far from dead.
